responsibility: Declares the `back` module surface for the GCC codegen backend by exposing the backend’s output-writing and LTO submodules.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `intrinsic/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is only a thin module organizer for backend emission infrastructure: the source contains just `pub mod lto;` and `pub mod write;`, so it exposes output/LTO submodules rather than implementing any lowering logic.
